scope: Measured CPU teaching runs on a tiny synthetic copy task. NOT a large-model or safety benchmark.
primary_evaluation_split: development probe (used for diagnosis); final_probe is separate and optional

data_card.split: development: please repeat; final probe: repeat please; SAME symbols/intents appear in training
data_card.scope: Tests template transfer on a tiny copy task, NOT unseen-intent generalization or LLM safety.
data_card.development_use: The initial held-out template was inspected during recipe diagnosis and is explicitly development data.
data_card.license: Authored synthetic data within this project; no third-party dataset. Repository distribution license is not selected.
data_card.labels: Correctness is exact matching; preference favors brief over verbose correct answers.

stages.comparison: Same warmup checkpoint, same training rows and update/token budget as full SFT; different learning rates.

stages.name: chosen_sft
stages.comparison: same effective response-token budget as DPO; different update count

training.reward: exact task verifier: brief correct=1, verbose correct=0.5, wrong=0
training.cost_scope: parameters, effective_training_tokens and optimizer_tensor_bytes describe the actor; wall time includes sampling, actor and critic updates

stages.name: distill

selection.selection_rule: first correct candidate per training prompt; no gold-response fallback

stages.start: warmup checkpoint; teacher passes a training-side quality gate

limitations: Only 8 held-out symbol cases; do not infer general LLM capability.
Held-out templates share symbols/intents with training; this is not unseen-intent OOD.
CPU timing depends on host load; optimizer bytes omit activation and allocator memory.
DPO/SimPO/PPO/GRPO use different objectives and compute; their loss values are not rankings.
No QLoRA or distributed GPU execution is claimed.

reward_model.scope: Correct-vs-wrong response ranking; labels are NOT features. This scorer is NOT the online RL reward.

raw_outputs: Each stage includes every held-out prompt, expected response and generated response. Recompute correctness from these, not from train loss.
